title: What is a fleet submarine?
text: A fleet submarine was a large ocean-going submarine designed for long patrols and independent operations.
display_citation: Sample FAQ — What is a fleet submarine?

title: How many men served on a WWII fleet boat?
text: Typical WWII U.S. fleet submarines carried roughly 70 to 80 men, depending on mission and wartime modifications.
